limitations: Search Analytics totals are queried at property level. Page/query rows are detail evidence, not total substitutes.
Query dimension omits anonymized queries and may return only top rows. A branded/nonbranded split from available queries is not a complete traffic split.
Google Search Console reports Google organic web search only, not all website sessions, paid traffic, direct traffic, referral traffic, phone leads, customers or revenue.
Latest observed final daily row is used as the shared end date. The absence of later rows does not by itself prove those dates have zero traffic.
URL inspection reports the indexed version, not a live test; no indexing request or sitemap submission is made.

observedQuerySplit.method: Case-insensitive expression matches AI First Solutions, AI Consulting SA, aiconsultingsa or Dominic. Other queries classified nonbrand. AI consulting San Antonio is a generic service/location phrase and is not treated as branded.
